meta.title: Government Fees for Foreign Investors — Saudi Arabia
meta.description: Official government fees for registration, licensing, and certification procedures relevant to foreign investors establishing a business in Saudi Arabia. All monetary amounts are in SAR. All entries are draft — amounts have not been independently verified against live official sources.
meta.last_verified: [PLACEHOLDER — update when entries are verified against current official fee schedules]

data.description: Fee charged by the Ministry of Investment (MISA) for processing and issuing an investment registration certificate for a foreign investor. This registration authorizes the investor to establish a Saudi legal entity for the approved activity. The fee amount is determined by MISA after application approval and is not published in advance.
data.placeholder_reason: Fee exists but amount is not published in advance. MISA determines the fee upon approval based on activity type and notifies the applicant. Payment required within 15 business days of notification — failure to pay voids the registration. Submit application via MISA e-portal to receive the fee amount. Do NOT assume this is free. Post-registration services (activity amendment, ownership amendment, property approval, cancellation) are confirmed no-fee. Source: MISA Investor Guide 12th Edition, July 2025, Section 3.1.1. Verify at: https://misa.gov.sa/app/uploads/2025/07/Investor-Guide_12-04.pdf

data.description: Fee charged by the Ministry of Investment (MISA) for amending the business activity on an existing Investment Registration. Confirmed zero fee per the official investor guide.
data.placeholder_reason: Confirmed zero fee per MISA Investor Guide, 12th Edition, July 2025. No fee is charged for activity amendment as a post-registration service.

data.description: Fee charged by the Ministry of Investment (MISA) for amending the ownership structure of an existing Investment Registration. Confirmed zero fee per the official investor guide.
data.placeholder_reason: Confirmed zero fee per MISA Investor Guide, 12th Edition, July 2025. No fee is charged for ownership amendment as a post-registration service.

data.description: Fee for the annual update of Investment Registration data required under the Investment Law Executive Regulations (Ministerial Decision 1086, February 2025). The fee amount is determined by MISA after the annual update cycle and is not published in advance. Same fee structure as the initial registration fee.
data.placeholder_reason: Fee exists but amount is not published in advance. MISA determines the annual renewal fee upon approval based on activity type and notifies the applicant. Payment required within 15 business days of notification — failure to pay voids the registration. Same fee structure applies to the Annual Registration Update as to the initial registration. Source: MISA Investor Guide 12th Edition, July 2025, Section 3.1.1. Verify at: https://misa.gov.sa/app/uploads/2025/07/Investor-Guide_12-04.pdf

data.description: Fee charged by the Ministry of Investment (MISA) for approving an investor's property-related request as part of post-registration services. Confirmed zero fee per the official investor guide.
data.placeholder_reason: Confirmed zero fee per MISA Investor Guide, 12th Edition, July 2025. No fee is charged for property approval as a post-registration service.

data.description: Fee charged by the Ministry of Investment (MISA) for cancelling an existing Investment Registration. Confirmed zero fee per the official investor guide.
data.placeholder_reason: Confirmed zero fee per MISA Investor Guide, 12th Edition, July 2025. No fee is charged for investment registration cancellation.

data.description: Fee charged by the Ministry of Commerce for the Single National Commercial Registration (SNCR). Under the April 2025 CR Law (Royal Decree M/83), a single national CR covers all activities and branches nationwide. CR is now permanent with no expiry date. Annual data verification and fee payment cycle replaces the prior periodic renewal requirement. New CR numbers are 10 digits starting with '7'.
data.placeholder_reason: Verified: SAR 200/year annual confirmation fee per Ministry of Commerce fee schedule (2025). CR is now permanent — no expiry date. Annual confirmation of data required to stay active. New 10-digit CR numbers starting with 7 replace old regional codes. Single CR covers all activities and branches nationwide (Royal Decree M/83, April 2025). Branch CRs abolished — see branch_commercial_registration_fee entry for historical reference. Chamber of Commerce membership fee (SAR 800+/year) is separate and mandatory — see chamber_of_commerce_fee entry. Verify current fee at mc.gov.sa.

data.description: Historical entry — Branch Commercial Registration (CR) fee under the pre-April 2025 system. Branch CRs were abolished effective April 3, 2025 under the new Commercial Registration Law (Royal Decree M/83). This entry is retained for historical reference only and does not reflect current law.
data.placeholder_reason: Branch CR (SAR 100/year) applied under the old system. ABOLISHED effective April 3, 2025 under the new Commercial Registration Law (Royal Decree M/83). A Single National CR now covers all activities and branches. Existing branch CRs have until April 2030 to convert or cancel. Exception: foreign company branches remain valid only if sole KSA registered entity of that foreign company. This entry is retained for historical reference only. Source: CR Law Royal Decree M/83, April 2025. Verify at: https://mc.gov.sa

data.description: Annual mandatory Chamber of Commerce membership fee payable by all Saudi-registered companies. Fee varies by company class. Class 3 (minimum) is SAR 800/year. Larger companies fall in higher classes with fees of SAR 10,000/year or more. Membership is required for CR issuance and renewal.
data.placeholder_reason: Verified: SAR 800/year minimum (Class 3) per Chamber of Commerce fee schedule (2025). Higher classes pay more — SAR 10,000+/year for large companies. The amount_sar recorded here represents the minimum Class 3 fee. Actual fee depends on company class. Verify current fee schedule at the relevant local Chamber of Commerce.

data.description: Fee, if any, charged by the General Organization for Social Insurance (GOSI) for registering as an employer. GOSI registration is required before hiring any employees in Saudi Arabia.
data.placeholder_reason: It is not confirmed whether GOSI charges a separate employer registration fee or whether registration is free at the point of enrollment. Ongoing GOSI contributions (a percentage of payroll) are separate from any registration fee and are not recorded here. Verify at gosi.gov.sa.

data.description: Fee, if any, charged by the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) for registering for VAT, zakat, or corporate income tax. VAT registration is required when taxable turnover meets or exceeds the statutory threshold.
data.placeholder_reason: It is not confirmed whether ZATCA charges a separate registration fee for VAT, zakat, or income tax registration, or whether registration is free. Ongoing tax obligations (VAT rates, CIT rates, zakat rates) are set by law and are not recorded as fees in this dataset. Verify at zatca.gov.sa.

placeholders.description: Whether ZATCA charges a fee for initial VAT, zakat, or income tax registration. Tax rates and thresholds are governed by Saudi tax law and are not recorded as fees in this dataset. Verify at zatca.gov.sa.

data.description: Corporate Income Tax (CIT) charged by ZATCA on the net adjusted annual profits of the foreign-owned portion of a Saudi company, or on a branch of a foreign company. Not a fixed-amount fee — CIT is a rate-based annual tax obligation. amount_sar is set to 0 as no fixed SAR amount applies; the applicable rate is 20% of net adjusted profits.
data.placeholder_reason: Corporate Income Tax: 20% of net adjusted annual profits. Applies to non-Saudi, non-GCC shareholders only. GCC shareholders pay Zakat (2.5%) instead — not CIT. Mixed ownership: CIT on foreign share, Zakat on Saudi/GCC share. Annual return due within 120 days of fiscal year end with audited financials. ZATCA registration required within 60 days of commencing business. Oil/hydrocarbon exception: 50–85%. PE risk: providing services in KSA for 183+ days in any 12-month period triggers CIT liability. Verify at: https://zatca.gov.sa

data.description: Zakat is an annual Islamic levy administered by ZATCA, charged on the Saudi and GCC-owned portions of a company's Zakat base (net worth). Not a fixed-amount fee — Zakat is a rate-based annual obligation. amount_sar is set to 0 as no fixed SAR amount applies; the applicable rate is 2.5% of the Zakat base.
data.placeholder_reason: Zakat: 2.5% of Zakat base (net worth, not profits). Applies to Saudi and GCC shareholders only — not to foreign shareholders. Zakat base includes: share capital, cash, receivables, inventory, retained earnings minus permissible liabilities. CIT and Zakat cannot offset each other. Annual filing due within 120 days of fiscal year end. Verify at: https://zatca.gov.sa

data.description: Withholding Tax (WHT) charged by ZATCA on certain payments made by Saudi-resident entities to non-resident entities. Rates vary by payment type. Not a fixed-amount fee — WHT is rate-based. amount_sar is set to 0 as no fixed SAR amount applies; applicable rates are 5–20% depending on payment category.
data.placeholder_reason: Withholding Tax on payments to non-residents: Dividends and interest: 5%. Royalties and IP licenses: 15%. Services and management fees: up to 20%. Due: within first 10 days of month following payment. May be reduced under applicable double tax treaty (55+ DTTs available). Verify at: https://zatca.gov.sa

data.description: Fee charged by the local municipality in Riyadh for issuing a commercial operating license (Balady license) for a business premises. The fee authorizes operation at a specific physical location. Fees vary by city, premises size, and activity type.
data.placeholder_reason: Municipal operating license fees vary by city, premises size, and business activity classification. The fee recorded here is specific to Riyadh. Fees for Jeddah, Dammam, and other cities may differ. Verify the current fee schedule with the relevant local municipality or at the Balady portal.

data.description: Fee, if any, charged by the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD) for issuing a Saudization compliance certificate or for registering on the Qiwa labor platform. Employers must meet Nitaqat (Saudization) thresholds to maintain work visa quotas and access to government services.
data.placeholder_reason: It is not confirmed whether MHRSD or Qiwa charge a fee for Saudization certificate issuance or labor platform registration. Nitaqat compliance fees, work visa (iqama) fees, and the expat levy (Hafiz) are separate and not recorded here. Verify at hrsd.gov.sa and qiwa.hrsd.gov.sa.
